name: Dock Worker McGee
description: A burly longshoreman who sees everything that happens at the docks.

initial_greeting.text: Aye, Detective. Looking for information? I might've seen something the night Steamwright died. Buy me a pint and I'll talk.

choices.text: Just tell me what you know.

information.text: Saw fancy carriages near the warehouses that night. Men in robes carrying something heavy. Heard they dumped it in the harbor. Could've been a body, could've been cargo. Either way, it was suspicious.

refused.text: Then I got nothing to say. Good day, Detective.
